name: CTDR Optimization Loop with Regularization
definition: An iterative optimization process that minimizes a loss function combining data fidelity (L2 or Student-t), edge, Laplacian, and flatness regularization terms to reconstruct a 3D mesh from 2D projections.
summary: CTDR Optimization Loop with Regularization reconstructs 3D meshes from 2D projections by minimizing composite loss with regularization, distinguished by explicit topological constraints via collision rollback and robust Student-t loss handling outliers.
